The '''Gallinore Reach''' is a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] within the [[Interior Region]]<ref name="TEA" /> and the [[Rifle Worlds]]<ref name="TEA" /> of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]]. It starts at the [[Gallinore system/Legends|Gallinore system]] then goes through the [[Relephon system/Legends|Relephon system]],<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Cheruba system/Legends|Cheruba system]],<ref name="TEA" /> and the [[Charubah system/Legends|Charubah system]]<ref name="TEA" /> to the [[Vergill system/Legends|Vergill system]] where it ends.
